# Smart City Parking Management System - Setup Guide

## Project Overview
A modern, fully-animated Smart City Parking Management website built with React and Vite. Features real-time parking spot tracking, live car counting, entry/exit management, and an interactive dashboard with occupancy statistics.

## Setup Progress

- [x] Verify copilot-instructions.md file exists
- [x] Clarify Project Requirements (React + Vite animated parking app)
- [x] Scaffold the Project (React + Vite structure)
- [ ] Customize with parking features
- [ ] Install dependencies
- [ ] Test the application
- [ ] Launch the development server

## Project Structure
- `src/` - React components and application logic
- `public/` - Static assets
- `package.json` - Dependencies and scripts
- `vite.config.js` - Build configuration

## Running the Project
```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

The application will be available at `http://localhost:5173`
